video_goal: Demonstrate a seamless neckline blend on a mannequin head using the taper lever adjustments of a BaByliss PRO GoldFX clipper.
single_prompt: A Medium Shot captures a hand picking up the gleaming gold BaByliss PRO GoldFX clipper with a metallic cylindrical body and exposed blade from a wooden table, bringing it next to the back of a mannequin head with synthetic hair. The camera smoothly transitions into an Extreme Close-up as a thumb pushes the side taper lever upward into the fully closed position. Pulling back to an Over-the-shoulder view, the flat cutting edge is pressed firmly against the bottom edge of the mannequin head's neckline. In a Close-up, the clipper moves upward in a short, outward-flicking C-stroke motion, cutting the bottom layer of synthetic hair to create a baseline. Pushing in for an Extreme Close-up, a thumb pulls the taper lever down exactly halfway, visibly exposing slightly more of the cutting blade. From an Over-the-shoulder view, the clipper is positioned half an inch above the newly cut baseline. A Close-up shows the clipper gliding upward with another C-stroke, blending the hair into the section just above the baseline. An Extreme Close-up captures the thumb pulling the taper lever all the way down to the fully open position. Retreating to an Over-the-shoulder view, the clipper is placed another half-inch higher on the neckline. In a Close-up, the clipper sweeps upward and flicks outward, seamlessly blending the faded section into the longer hair above. Shifting to a Medium Close-up, a small wooden fade brush sweeps rapidly across the mannequin's neck, clearing away the cut hair clippings. Finally, a Macro pan slowly moves across the back of the mannequin head, revealing a smooth, blended gradient on the neckline, all set against a warm-lit barbershop environment with a blurred wooden table in the background.
